title: Transcriptome data of nuclear family carrying de novo CNV
description: We have described a family with a de novo 1 Mb duplication involving 18 genes on chromosome 19. The CNV was confirmed as de novo in the mother and inherited by both sons using qPCR. We describe whole transcriptome data on family. Also see accession number PRJNA625607.
